youtube_description:
1. Does Momentum and Position Operators  Commute?
2. What does the answer to the first question imply regarding the Momentum and Position observables?

In this video, we tackle an example where determines whether or not the momentum and position operators commute. We then find whether or not momentum and position observables can be determined simultaneously.

Take note of the product rule when tackling this problem.

Take note of this video:

Have a Fantastic Day!
